blocks.text: Today’s headlines: Apollo Quiboloy, Sara Duterte, Lula da Silva
Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: Court issues arrest warrant vs Quiboloy, others over US extradition request

blocks.text: The Makati City Regional Trial Court issues an arrest warrant against doomsday sect leader Apollo Quiboloy and two others.

items: Sara Duterte held dollar accounts, BPI confirms

blocks.text: It turns out, Vice President Sara Duterte has dollar accounts, based on a letter the bank BPI sent to the Senate as the impeachment court.

items: Marcos picks COA chair Cordoba as new Supreme Court associate justice

blocks.text: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. appoints Commission on Audit chairperson Gamaliel Cordoba as an associate justice of the Supreme Court.

items: Brazil’s Lula arrives in Manila for state visit, ASEAN Summit

blocks.text: Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva arrives in Manila for a state visit on Friday, November 13, ahead of his participation in the 49th ASEAN Summit.

items: Former Nvidia CEO Huang had a relationship with a second employee, sources say

blocks.text: Reuters reports, former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang had a third extramarital affair, this time with another employee. – Rappler.com
